title: Gerente de Mudança
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter o Plano de Gestão da Mudança do programa;
  • Realizar análise de impacto organizacional (processos, pessoas, sistemas e cultura);
  • Mapear stakeholders e definir estratégias de engajamento por público;
  • Identificar riscos de adoção e definir planos de mitigação;
  • Construir e executar o plano de comunicação da mudança;
  • Atuar como facilitador entre áreas de negócio, TI e liderança;
  • Preparar lideranças para atuarem como patrocinadores da mudança;
  • Conduzir ações de alinhamento com áreas impactadas (field, corporativo, regionais);
  • Definir e executar estratégias de treinamento e capacitação dos usuários;
  • Trabalhar com times de BI e Produto para garantir usabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio;
  • Desenvolver materiais de apoio (guias, FAQs, vídeos, jornadas do usuário);
  • Monitorar indicadores de adoção, uso e maturidade do Painel de Vendas;
  • Integrar o plano de mudança ao cronograma do programa;
  • Participar de ritos de governança e status reports;
  • Apoiar a gestão de impactos em releases, pilotos e rollouts;
  • Coletar feedback contínuo e promover ajustes na estratégia de mudança;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs de mudança (adoção, engajamento, satisfação);
  • Avaliar readiness organizacional e evolução pós-implantação;
  • Apoiar a captura e realização dos benefícios do programa.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificação em Change Management (Prosci, CCMP ou similar);
  • Vivência em programas de transformação digital;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de mudança (ex.: Prosci / ADKAR, Kotter ou similares);
  • Experiência com projetos de grande escala e múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de análise de impacto organizacional;
  • Experiência com estratégias de comunicação e treinamento;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis e híbridos (Agile + PMO).

Informações adicionais

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Bônus anual;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;
  • Wellhub (plataforma de bem-estar que oferece opções de atividades físicas, mindfulness e outros);
  • Educa Mais (planos personalizados de graduação, pós-graduação, mentorias, cursos livres e de idiomas);
  • Chip Pague Menos Celular;
  • Desconto em aluguéis de carro;
  • Desconto em passagens áreas;
  • Estacionamento (conforme disponibilidade);
  • Ginástica laboral, conforme a localidade.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Service Now Engineer - Hybrid Madrid
description:
We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

What we look for?

We are looking for Senior ServiceNow Engineer , to contribute in a project with one of our global customer in wealth management. We are building a very strong team comprised of high caliber professionals that will work closely with the client’s IT and Business stakeholders to deliver impactful programs.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects with talented colleagues in an international environment while developing your domain knowledge working for a top company.

Work Location: Work model in hybrid in Madrid (3 days at the office, 2 WFH),

Important note: This position requires relocation to Madrid, Spain. While the relocation is being arranged, the selected candidate will work remotely following Spanish business hours (CET). Once in Madrid, the role will be hybrid, combining on-site and remote work days.

Main tasks and accountabilities will be:

  • Lead end-to-end design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across multiple instances, with emphasis on core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management) and enterprise-wide integrations.
  • Develop and optimise custom applications, workflows, and automation using Flow Designer, Business Rules, UI Actions, Client Scripts, and GlideAjax, ensuring alignment with ITIL v3/v4 best practices.
  • Configure and enhance the ServiceNow Service Portal and customer-facing interfaces, utilising JavaScript and AngularJS to deliver intuitive user experiences.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with external systems via REST/SOAP web services, MID Server, and Integration Hub, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange in compliance with audit and segregation-of-duties requirements.

What do we expect from you?

  • Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, with proven involvement in full lifecycle implementations.
  • Certification(s): Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or System Administrator
  • Understanding of ITIL v3/v4 frameworks and their practical application within ServiceNow.
  • Deep expertise in core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request)
  • Experience in additional modules considered advantageous, e.g. Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Proficient in server-side and client-side scripting : o GlideAjax, Business Rules, UI Actions, Client Scripts o JavaScript knowledge, including Service Portal scripting with AngularJS

What can we offer?

  • 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
  • Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).
  • Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)
  • Free access to several training platforms
  • Professional stability and career plans
  • UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
  • The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
  • Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
  • UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Integrations & APIs)
description:
Location: Hybrid — Curitiba, Brazil (1–2 days/week on-site)

Type: Contract (PJ)

Salary: $2800 - $3800 (Depending on experience and English fluency)

Schedule: Must be available to work US hours (Mountain Standard Time - MST)

About WAVV

WAVV is an innovative integrated dialer solution designed to enhance the efficiency of modern outbound revenue teams. Our multi-line power dialer seamlessly integrates with CRMs, enabling teams to triple call volumes without fatigue or risking spam flags. Offering features like real-time spam protection, dedicated local numbers for higher answer rates, and unlimited calls, WAVV optimizes outbound communication.   • Experience integrating with third-party APIs, including major CRM platforms (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with JSON, webhooks, and event-driven systems
  • Experience with async processing and queues (BullMQ, SQS, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Solid understanding of retries, idempotency, and data consistency
  • Ability to design and maintain reliable sync pipelines
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with specific CRM APIs (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • AI tooling familiarity
  • Experience with high-volume data processing
  • DevOps/cloud deployment experience
  • Prior startup experience

What You’ll Get

  • Real ownership over your work and visibility into how it impacts users
  • Collaboration with a sharp team across product, design, and leadership
  • A fast-moving environment where ideas are welcomed and results matter
  • Competitive salary: $2,800 – $3,800 USD/month (PJ contract)
  • Unlimited PTO and true flexibility
  • Team lunches and regular team-building activities

Things to Consider

  • This is a Contract (PJ) position with potential for growth
  • Hybrid role: 1–2 days per week in the Curitiba office, remaining days remote
  • Must have a flexible schedule and be available to work during U.S. hours (MST)
  • Strong written English required
  • Comfortable speaking English in meetings and technical discussions

We’re not hiring just to fill a seat. We’re hiring someone who wants to make a difference, contribute at a high level, and help us scale with quality and clarity. If that sounds like you, let’s talk!

Please make sure to include a copy of your resume in English and to take our quick Culture Survey!

title: Senior Manager Medical Affairs
description:
The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs will be responsible for our Injectables aesthetics business.

This role will report to our Brazil Country Lead with a dotted report line to the Global Medical Affairs.

Location

Brazil (São Paulo preferred; hybrid/field-based with national travel)

The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs – Brazil is responsible for leading and executing the local medical strategy for the injectable aesthetic portfolio. This includes medical leadership for two promoted products and governance and rollout of a new or updated injectable protocol. The role ensures scientific excellence, compliant medical engagement, strong KOL partnerships, and effective cross-functional collaboration with Commercial, Regulatory, Quality, and Market Access teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the Brazil Medical Plan aligned with global strategy and country business priorities.
  • Provide medical input into brand plans, ensuring all claims and materials are evidence-based and compliant.
  • Lead medical governance and adaptation of new injectable protocols, including scientific rationale, safety considerations, and training framework.
  • Establish version control and structured review processes for protocol updates.
  • Build and manage strategic relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), anaesthesiologists, and relevant specialists.
  • Lead advisory boards, expert meetings, and scientific exchange activities.
  • Design and deliver high-quality medical education for internal teams and healthcare professionals.
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulations and internal policies, including pharmacovigilance and adverse event reporting.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Regulatory (including ANVISA requirements), Quality, Commercial, and Market Access.
  • Provide timely and scientifically robust responses to medical inquiries.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree (MD, PharmD, MSc, or PhD preferred).
  • Minimum 8–10 years’ experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical, or Scientific roles within injectables, anaesthesia, hospital products, or specialty pharma.
  • Strong experience supporting product launches and lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated expertise in KOL engagement and medical education program development.
  • Solid understanding of pharmacovigilance and compliance requirements in Brazil.
  • Fluent Portuguese and strong English proficiency.

Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Effective delivery of Brazil Medical Plan and launch readiness milestones.
  • Successful rollout and adoption of new injectable protocol.
  • Strong KOL engagement and quality scientific exchange.

title: AI Engineer - Full Stack Builder
description:
About Cambay Solutions

Cambay Solutions is the technology arm of the Cambay Group, a 1,300-employee organization headquartered in Houston, Texas. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner holding all six solution designations, we help enterprises across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and government transform operations through Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and AI. Our AI Practice operates as the strategic hub that powers intelligent solutions across every Cambay practice area.

About the Role

At Cambay, our Full Stack Builders take client solutions end-to-end – combining architecture, development, AI integration, and user experience to deliver what traditionally required a team of 5–10 specialists.

As a Full Stack Builder in the AI Practice, you will own the complete solution lifecycle for client engagements. Using AI-powered development tools and the Azure ecosystem, you will design, build, and ship solutions that solve real enterprise problems. This is not a generalist role – it’s a new category of consulting professional who leverages AI to amplify their capabilities across the entire delivery stack.

Key Responsibilities

• End-to-End Delivery – Own client solutions from discovery through deployment – you are responsible for the complete delivery lifecycle within your pod engagements

• AI-Powered Development – Leverage GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and custom AI agents to accelerate development across spec writing, design, architecture, and code

• Azure Architecture – Design and implement scalable solutions using Azure services – App Service, Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure AI, Container Apps, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365

• User Experience – Create user experiences using modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js) with AI-assisted prototyping and design systems

• AI Integration – Embed Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, Copilot Studio agents, and custom AI features into client solutions

• Client Engagement – Participate in client discovery, contribute to solution estimation and SOWs, and communicate technical approaches to non-technical stakeholders

• Ship & Iterate – Deploy to production on client Azure tenants, configure monitoring, gather feedback, and iterate based on real-world usage

• Cross-Practice Collaboration – Work within Cambay’s Hub-and-Spoke model, collaborating with domain specialists in Modern Work, D365, and Data & Analytics practices

Required Qualifications

Technical Foundation

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (TypeScript, Python, C# preferred)

• Experience building and deploying applications on Azure (or equivalent cloud platform)

• Understanding of modern web development (React, APIs, databases)

• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, integration patterns, and Azure AI services

• Experience with Power Platform and/or Dynamics 365 integration is a strong plus

Consulting & Delivery Mindset

• Comfort working directly with enterprise clients – discovery sessions, demos, technical walkthroughs

• Ability to work across multiple concurrent engagements within pod structures

• Demonstrated ability to identify client problems and translate them into implementable solutions

• Track record of shipping solutions that deliver measurable business value

AI-Native Working Style

• Active use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, etc.) as part of daily workflow

• Comfort with rapid experimentation and learning new tools under delivery timelines

• Curiosity to explore how AI can amplify your capabilities and accelerate client delivery

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Azure, Microsoft Foundry platform and Agent 365

• Familiarity with Copilot Studio agent development

• Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Developer Associate, Solutions Architect)

• Experience with design tools (Figma) or AI-assisted prototyping

• Healthcare, financial services, or government domain experience

• Background in consulting, professional services, or agency delivery environments

How We’ll Evaluate You

We value demonstrated capability over credentials. You may apply with a traditional resume, or you can show us what you’ve built:

• Demo Video – Walk us through a solution you’ve built (2–3 minutes). Show the problem, your approach, and the outcome.

• Why & How – Explain why you built it, the architectural decisions you made, and what you learned.

• AI Usage – Tell us how you used AI tools in your process – we want to see your AI-native workflow in action.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Credix

is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer . You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.

Responsibilities

  • Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment.
  • Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria.
  • Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours.
  • Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed.
  • Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
  • Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
  • Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs.
  • Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
  • Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
  • Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
  • Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
  • Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Closer
description:
( VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL / MODELO PJ )

A allu é uma startup em crescimento , feita por pessoas que acreditam que o trabalho impulsiona nossos sonhos e faz a vida girar com propósito. Aqui, fazemos o que é certo, custe o que custar e vestimos a camisa de um desafio maior: transformar o jeito como o mundo consome.

Na allu , acreditamos que resultado real precisa ser visto. Reconhecemos quem faz acontecer e valorizamos o impacto das entregas concretas. Isso porque, no fim, conquistar é sobre ver o esforço ganhar forma e ser celebrado.

Somos movidos por excelência e velocidade, porque acreditamos que só assim as coisas boas deixarão de ser privilégio de poucos. Nossa missão é impactar 1 bilhão de pessoas com as nossas soluções de assinatura. Para isso, tomamos decisões rápidas, com ousadia e sempre com foco em melhorar a vida dos nossos clientes.

Aqui, cada conquista tem um nome: pessoas reais que fazem acontecer. Buscamos pessoas com quem possamos contar, apoiar no crescimento e ter orgulho de chamar de ranger . Procuramos pessoas analíticas, honestas e que tragam leveza para a jornada — porque aqui, a diversão também faz parte do caminho.

Quer fazer parte de algo realmente grande e aprender MUITO ao lado das pessoas mais determinadas e apaixonadas pelo que fazem? Então #vemserallu!

O que você fará no dia a dia?

  1. Você irá atuar na área de captação de investimentos via pessoa física da allu. O seu papel é contribuir na construção da carteira de investidores da Allu;
  2. Atender às oportunidades recebidas pelo time de Marketing e de Pré-Vendas;
  3. Diagnosticar e entender os objetivos, desafios do potencial cliente;
  4. Realizar apresentações consultivas via videochamada sobre o modelo de negócio da allu para os potenciais investidores;
  5. Conduzir follow-ups e seguir com a negociação com o potencial investidor (pessoa física);
  6. Preencher e alimentar o CRM com informações relevantes das negociações e gerenciar o seu próprio fluxo de tarefas de negociação;
  7. Formalizar e concluir o processo de captação de investimento junto ao investidor.

O que esperamos de você?

Precisamos de uma pessoa organizada, muito atenta aos processos e disciplinada. Adaptabilidade é extremamente importante já que, a nossa operação atualiza constantemente/intensamente os seus processos. A nossa operação tem o objetivo de gerar captação de investimento, mas ainda assim é uma operação muito mais comercial do que qualquer coisa, por isso a veia, apetite e cultura de vendas são indispensáveis. Você trabalhará com metas e desafios diários , por isso precisamos que você tenha uma forte orientação para resultados e um alto comprometimento com os mesmos.

Por isso, precisamos que você possua:

  1. Graduação em Engenharias, Administração, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência comprovada na área de vendas/área comercial;
  3. Experiência com apresentações para clientes externos;
  4. Boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  5. Experiência em trabalhar com CRMs;
  6. Familiaridade com frameworks de vendas.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  1. Já ter experiência com o CRM Hubspot;
  2. Interesse em atuar com Investimentos.

Aqui na allu PJ tem alguns diferencias! São eles:

  1. Flash Benefícios de R$1.540,00/mês para mercado, restaurantes ou aquele delivery – o valor é fixo independente de meses com feriados ou não.
  2. Day Off no mês do seu aniversário para curtir essa data especial.

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.

What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level

About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.

This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.

What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined

Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up

How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.

We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.

What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.

Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation

Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Coordenador de Novos Negócios PE
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!

Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.

Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).

Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.

E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Acompanhamento das metas individuais: Estabelecer metas personalizadas para cada HC com base no seu histórico de vendas, potenciais de mercado e perfil. Monitorar continuamente o desempenho individual de cada um para garantir que estejam atingindo suas metas;
  • Análise de indicadores de performance (KPIs): Monitorar métricas como volume de vendas, taxa de conversão, número de leads convertidos, ticket médio, entre outros. Analisar e comparar o desempenho de cada HC;
  • Feedback personalizado e coaching: Realizar reuniões de feedback individuais para discutir pontos fortes e áreas de melhoria, oferecendo coaching focado em como aumentar a performance de vendas, seja ajustando técnicas de abordagem ou estratégias de fechamento;
  • Alinhamento estratégico de leads: Organizar e distribuir os leads qualificados de forma estratégica para cada HC, considerando a especialização e histórico de vendas de cada um. Isso maxima a probabilidade de conversão de cada oportunidade;
  • Aproveitamento de materiais de apoio: Assegurar que as equipes estejam utilizando os materiais de apoio de forma eficiente durante o processo de vendas, seja personalizando apresentações ou usando conteúdo relevante para cada tipo de cliente;
  • Customização dos materiais de apoio: Auxiliar as equipes a adaptarem os materiais de apoio de acordo com a abordagem do cliente, aumentando as chances de conversão. Isso pode incluir ajustar apresentações de vendas ou ter versões mais específicas do material dependendo da fase do funil de vendas;
  • Oferecer capacitações e desenvolvimento avançados e atualizações constantes sobre novos produtos, técnicas de vendas e mudanças no mercado;
  • Workshops de técnicas de fechamento: Realizar workshops focados em técnicas de fechamento, negociação e superação de objeções, além de treinamentos específicos para melhorar habilidades de relacionamento com clientes de alto valor;
  • Desenvolvimento de competências estratégicas: Investir no desenvolvimento das competências de estratégia de vendas, liderança e gestão de tempo, ajudando cada HC a se tornar mais eficiente e eficaz na gestão do seu pipeline de vendas;
  • Foco no pós-venda: Assegurar que os HCs mantenham um relacionamento pós-venda forte, usando estratégias de fidelização para garantir que os clientes voltem e recomendem a empresa, além de identificar novas oportunidades de vendas dentro da base de clientes existente;
  • Gestão de grandes contas: Ajudar os HCs a gerenciar suas grandes contas e clientes-chave, garantindo que eles sejam bem atendidos e que todas as suas necessidades sejam atendidas, o que pode gerar mais vendas e oportunidades de cross-selling e upselling;
  • Análise e definição de estratégias de vendas: Definir e ajustar as estratégias gerais de vendas com base nos resultados obtidos pela equipe de HCs. Estabelecer planos de ação para superar desafios ou aproveitar novas oportunidades de mercado;
  • Gestão do ciclo de vendas: Trabalhar com a equipe para gerenciar os ciclos de vendas de forma eficaz, identificando gargalos no processo e implementando soluções rápidas e eficazes;
  • Criar um ambiente competitivo saudável: Fomentar uma cultura onde cada HC se sinta desafiado a melhorar constantemente, com feedbacks contínuos, oportunidades de crescimento e espaço para evolução;
  • Promoção da ética e transparência: Garantir que a equipe mantenha os mais altos padrões éticos e de transparência em suas práticas de vendas, especialmente em situações que envolvem grandes valores ou negociações complexas.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade, Economia e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes de vendas de alta performance, preferencialmente com HCs, demonstrando um histórico de sucesso em alcançar e superar metas de vendas;
  • Profundo conhecimento de estratégias e técnicas de vendas, incluindo negociação, fechamento de vendas, e gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e adaptada às necessidades do mercado de telecomunicações e PME, compreendendo as particularidades de cada segmento e traduzindo soluções para essas realidades;
  • Experiência em negociação e fechamento de vendas;
  • Experiência em vendas empresariais.

E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

· E muito mais!

Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)!

title: Field Representative
description:
Sobre a vaga

Título da vaga: Representante de Coleta de Dados em Campo

Tipo de vaga: Regular, período integral. De segunda a sexta-feira

Período do contrato: 10 dias úteis (incluindo treinamento) – Temporário

Local: Brasília, Brasil

Descrição da vaga:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Coleta de Dados em Campo em Taipei, Taiwan, para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá deslocamentos a pé até os locais designados.

No entanto, os participantes podem usar bicicletas/patinetes/outros meios de transporte, se desejarem.

Natureza do trabalho:

Verificação a pé de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e estabelecimentos similares.

Iremos fornecer:

Uma lista de instalações a serem verificadas + uma camada de pontos com as localizações

Instruções para a pesquisa

Aplicativo móvel (Android/iOS) compatível com Android 10 e iOS

O pesquisador precisará se deslocar até o Ponto de Interesse (POI) e verificar/coletar algumas informações, que podem envolver de 5 a 10 parâmetros, além de tirar uma foto da placa e da entrada principal.

Recomendamos a coleta a pé; no entanto, os pesquisadores podem usar bicicleta, patinete ou outro meio de transporte, se preferirem.

Requisitos:

Residir em Brasília ou arredores, Brasil

Proficiência em inglês (leitura e conversação)

Capacidade de se deslocar a pé ou utilizar transporte para verificar o POI (Ponto de Interesse)

Job Title: Field Data Representative

Employment Type: Regular, full-time. Monday to Friday

Contract period: 10 Days work include training

Location: Brasília , Brazil.

Job Description:

Aceolution is urgently hiring Field Data Representatives in Águas Claras, Federal District, Brazil to verify points of interest (POI) based on specific survey instructions. This will involve walking in assigned locations.

However, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he wants.

Nature of work:

Pedestrian verification of POIs (Point of Interest) which can be amongst hotels, gas stations, restaurants and the likes. We’ll provide: - The list of facilities to verify + the point layer with locations - Survey instructions - Mobile app (Android/iOS) that works on Android 10 and iOS The surveyor will need to walk to the POI and check/collect some information that may involve 5-10 parameters about it and take a picture of the entrance. We recommend on-feet collection; however, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he/she wants.

Requirements:

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.

What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.

2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.

Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .

description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. Quem procuramos

Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:

  • Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade

Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.

Faça parte da nossa história

title: Entrevistador(a) de Campo
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!

title: Engenharia de Software Sênior (DBRE)
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

O objetivo é aplicar o conceito you build it, you run it, reduzindo esforço operacional e acelerando a evolução dos produtos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Engenharia de Software Sênior , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Estamos construindo a nova plataforma de cartões do Itaú, que hoje atende mais de 30% dos nossos clientes. Buscamos uma pessoa especialista DBRE, com perfil hands-on e forte engajamento para desenvolver jornadas de daily banking.

Seu primeiro desafio será apoiar na organização do IDP da Nova Plataforma de Cartões, atuando com um time forte de engenharia e produto.

Nessa função você vai:

  • Zelar pela disponibilidade, performance, capacidade, mudanças, monitoração e respostas de emergência
  • Prover soluções em Cloud AWS
  • Contribuir com a agenda SRE na comunidade
  • Construir estratégia e apoiar em todo o ciclo de vida dos dados
  • Suportar um ambiente de banco de dados SQL e NoSQL
  • Apoiar o processo de modelagem dos dados para maximizar performance
  • Implementar abordagens de Disaster Recovery de dados de serviços de missão crítica
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos dados para minimizar custos e maximizar disponibilidade

Você atuará em um ambiente com tecnologias desafiadoras, como AWS, Kubernetes, SQL e NoSQL, APM, CI/CD, self-healing, TDD, Kotlin, GoLang, Python, Mobile (iOS e Android) e Machine Learning. O trabalho acontece em squads multidisciplinares envolvendo negócio, design, backend, frontend e confiabilidade.

A posição envolve disciplinas de DBRE, liderança técnica em temas como arquitetura de dados, performance tuning e troubleshooting, abordagens SRE em infraestrutura e cloud, automatização (CI/CD) e observabilidade, além do atendimento de incidentes críticos (incluindo sob regime de sobreaviso).

Ao se tornar um ituber você tem_

  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
  • Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass
  • Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Consultor(a) de Auditoria de Fretes - Especialista em TRAX

E muito mais!

description:

Escolha seu impacto .

de acordo com a especialidade do consultor), LTMC / Migration Cockpit, SCP – SAP Cloud

Platform, SAP BTP – Business Technology Platform, ABAP (Debug Funcional)

Com mais de 180 anos de história, a Deloitte está hoje em mais de 150 países e territórios.

Deloitte no Brasil

Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

title: Analista de Processos e Dados
description:
Código da Vaga: 58549

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Análise de processos com base em relatórios e dashboards.

Acompanhamento de KPIs e OKRs

Elaboração de estimativas e correlação de dados para diagnóstico de causa raiz.

Métodos ágeis: Scrum e Kanban.

Ferramentas: JIRA, Data Studio, Power BI, Excel.

Conhecimento da esteira de projetos.

Uso de modelos estatísticos para gerar novas visões e acompanhar projetos

Soft Skills:

Habilidade analítica.

Correlação de dados e estimativas.

Capacidade de entrega.

Senso crítico.

Desejável experiência com canais digitais, qualidade ou jornada do cliente.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no São Paulo 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Sobre o Papel

Um Engenheiro(a) de IA - Automação e Chatbots será responsável por arquitetar e desenvolver chatbots inteligentes multicanal, criar e manter pipelines de automação de processos com IA, implementar workflows de geração de código assistida por IA, integrar modelos de linguagem com APIs de negócio e desenvolver agentes autônomos para tarefas operacionais da fintech.

Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver chatbots inteligentes multicanal (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS) com fluxos conversacionais avançados usando LLMs — atendendo servidores públicos em simulação, contratação e suporte.

  • Implementar workflows de geração de código assistida por IA, otimizando o ciclo de desenvolvimento da equipe (prompts, agentes, code review automatizado).
  • Integrar modelos de linguagem (OpenAI, Claude, modelos open-source) com APIs de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos para tarefas operacionais da fintech.
  • Projetar arquiteturas com MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG e function calling.

Qualificações

  • Experiência prática com C#/.NET e/ou Node.js (TypeScript) — você é dev antes de ser "de IA".
  • Domínio de PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Vivência com AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, S3 ou similares).
  • Experiência real construindo chatbots em produção (não apenas provas de conceito).
  • Domínio de prompt engineering, function calling, RAG e orquestração de agentes.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação (n8n, LangChain, CrewAI ou similares).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Evolution API ou integrações WhatsApp Business API.
  • Conhecimento em Supabase (pgvector, Edge Functions).
  • Vivência com MCP Servers e arquiteturas de agentes conectados a ferramentas.
  • Experiência no setor financeiro, fintechs ou crédito consignado.
  • Conhecimento em LGPD aplicada a tratamento de dados com IA.
  • Portfólio de bots ou automações em produção que você possa demonstrar.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English

Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!
